spec_features.spec_quote: A single run cannot burn unbounded cost, wall time, or steps, even if the subject loops forever.
spec_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:85 `for step in range(self.config.max_steps)` with else->'step_budget' at :165; :86-88 wall check `if time.time()-t0 > max_wall_seconds: break terminated_reason='wall_budget'`; :89-91 `if total_in+total_out > max_total_tokens: break 'token_budget'`. All three caps are checked each iteration and break the loop. Cost itself is only recorded (trace.cost_usd at :169), not capped, but steps/wall/tokens bound the run.
spec_features.notes: Cost is not directly capped but is bounded indirectly via token/step/wall caps.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enforces budgets/guardrails so a runaway loop cannot burn unbounded cost or wall time.

spec_features.evidence: All read and acted on in subject_loop.run(): max_steps (:85, else:165), max_wall_seconds (:86), max_total_tokens (:89), identical_call_cap (:152 `if identical_streak >= self.config.identical_call_cap: break 'identical_loop'`), idle_turn_cap (:157 `if idle_streak >= self.config.idle_turn_cap: break 'idle'`), allow_abandon_signal (:145 gates the ABANDON break). Each is compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Note JudgeConfig.idle_steps_for_abandon (config.py:76) is a separate judge-side value; the loop-level idle_turn_cap is the enforced one.

spec_features.spec_quote: The system prompt tells the subject it may say the word `ABANDON`... to stop. The loop detects this and terminates
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (subject_loop.py:59-60) 'If you believe a task is genuinely impossible, you may say the word ABANDON and stop calling tools.' Loop at :145-150 `if allow_abandon_signal and ('ABANDON' in text.upper() or _abandon_phrased(text)): evt.note='abandon_signal'; terminated_reason='abandoned'; break`. The instruction is delivered AND the trigger is honored as a hard stop.
spec_features.notes: Also re-prompted at :120 ('...say ABANDON.'). _abandon_phrased adds fast-path phrases (:180-187).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # allow the subject to "give up" explicitly

spec_features.feature_name: abandon avoids forced thrash to budget cap
spec_features.spec_quote: It also keeps the loop from forcing a model... to thrash until it hits a budget cap
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: the ABANDON break at subject_loop.py:145-150 fires before/independently of the step/token/wall caps, so a subject that signals abandonment exits early rather than running to a budget cap. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the ABANDON feature framed by purpose; implementation identical.

code_only_features.evidence: subject_loop.py:162-164 `if any(r.structured.get('passed') for r in results...): evt.note='tests_passed'; terminated_reason='completed'; break` — stops the run when the task is solved, ending the stress early.

subject_loop.py:152-160 break the loop on repeated identical tool calls (identical_loop) and on consecutive no-tool turns (idle), ending a thrashing run before budget caps. (Counted separately as enforced guards.)
